lineage.description: Population and household data from 2013 census were spatially joined with village boundary polygons and a 1 km coastal buffer zone to identify and quantify populations in coastal proximity across Wallis and Futuna. This analysis supports understanding of exposure to coastal hazards in Pacific Island territories.
